map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Henry, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-25 03:00): early in person 24,581 (state 22,185). Clermont (as of 2026-10-25 01:51): mail returned 9,071 (state 8,719); early in person 11,075 (state 10,083). Crawford (as of 2026-10-24 15:45): mail returned 1,494 (state 1,422); early in person 2,176 (state 2,064). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-23 18:03): early in person 24,843 (state 24,776). Franklin (as of 2026-10-25 00:12): mail returned 50,150 (state 45,375); early in person 54,708 (state 48,799); ballots sent 81,403 (state 80,059). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-23 19:44): early in person 37,411 (state 37,076). Hancock: mail returned 2,081 (state 1,948); early in person 5,826 (state 5,646). Henry (as of 2026-10-24 14:41): early in person 2,009 (state 1,892). Morrow (as of 2026-10-24 15:44): mail returned 956 (state 901); early in person 2,089 (state 1,972). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-24 09:38): mail returned 8,247 (state 7,250); early in person 10,254 (state 9,380).
